directions.title: Four disciplines, one point of responsibility
directions.intro: Every project has a single accountable contractor — from the first estimate to the signed acceptance certificate. You don't have to coordinate several firms.

items.text: Private houses and apartment buildings, from foundations to handover.

items.text: Apartments, houses and premises: rough and finishing works, building services, interior finishes.

items.text: Earthworks, road bases, access roads and site landscaping.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: What personal data the ElGo website collects, why, and how to request deletion.
privacy.draft: Draft. To be reviewed by a lawyer for compliance with the RA Law on Protection of Personal Data.

sections.title: 1. Who processes the data
body: The data controller is ElGo LLC («ԷԼԳՕ» ՍՊԸ), state registration 273.110.1441879 of 27.02.2025. Address: 76 Nork 2nd Lane, Nork-Marash, Yerevan. Phone: +374 43 357 007.

sections.title: 2. What data we collect
body: Through the enquiry form we receive only what you enter yourself: your name, phone number and the selected project type.

To protect against spam, the server temporarily keeps track of the IP address an enquiry was sent from. The IP address is not stored with the enquiry and is removed from the server's memory within 10 minutes.

sections.title: 3. Why
body: The only purpose is to contact you about your enquiry: to clarify the task, arrange a site visit and prepare an estimate. We do not use this data for mailings and do not share it with third parties for marketing.

sections.title: 4. Where the data is stored
body: The enquiry is delivered to the company's private work chat in Telegram, accessible only to the staff handling enquiries. Enquiries are not stored on the website server.
[To be confirmed: how long enquiries are kept in the work chat and who has access to it.]

sections.title: 5. Your rights
body: You can ask at any time what data we hold about you, request its correction or deletion. Call +374 43 357 007 or write to [email]. We will respond within [N] business days.

sections.title: 6. Cookies and analytics
body: The website does not use advertising cookies or third-party analytics.

sections.title: 7. Changes
body: The current version of this policy is always published on this page.
